name: qfd_vm_bay_pad15s0-bp2-a6a2fb5a8
purpose: Qwen TP8 VM lane-bay PILOT (vm_pad_15_S0, the fullest pad-row bay: 6 closed tiles in 6 slots at the plan pitch 21.6 um, 4.32-um channels, 200 lanes of 8 b, 3520 stage bits; wires + hard children only): measures the real congestion / DRC / timing of abutted relay and pad tiles with their closed pins before the band and region clusters are cut. Bench = every lane against its planned me-enabled stage count, every clock; mutants: one lane a tile short, two lanes swapped.
